summary: GSK plc filed a Form 6-K to notify the market of an admission to trading of 70,759 ordinary shares under an existing block listing for the GlaxoSmithKline plc Share Save Plan 2022. The shares are fully fungible with existing shares and were admitted to the London Stock Exchange Main Market. No price, premium, or structure terms are disclosed as this is a routine share issuance notification. The filing is a standard regulatory requirement for share plans and does not represent a special situation. There are no deal terms or risk-arb angle to monitor.
